jobs.title: Associate Manager, Corporate Content Creator
jobs.workModel: Office based, up to 2 days a week from home
jobs.notes: Hands-on video role in LEGO's Corporate Communications team: spotting stories inside the company, then filming and editing short and long-form content with executives and colleagues for corporate social channels. This is very close to your LinkedIn video work at VELUX, and the ad is in English. Pay is not stated. Posted today with 34 applicants, and they review applications on a rolling basis, so apply soon.

jobs.title: Communications Specialist
jobs.notes: Storytelling role for the Squamish Nation's economic development corporation: social, web, newsletters, speeches and video scripts, working with photographers and videographers. Your anthropology background and storytelling are a natural fit for telling the story of Indigenous economic development. Vancouver, hybrid, pay above your floor. 48 people have clicked apply.

jobs.title: Video Producer Specialist
jobs.notes: Veo has reposted its in-house video production job (the old link from October has closed), so it is still open. Hands-on video work at a Copenhagen sports tech scaleup where Danish is only a plus, and your VELUX video work and films cover the 3+ years asked. On-site rather than hybrid. Reposted today with only 9 applicants so far.

jobs.title: Outreach Coordinator, DTU Nanolab
jobs.notes: Science communication and outreach events for an EU quantum technology project with about 30 partners: event coordination, newsletters, social media and making videos and posters. English-language role, 32 to 37 hours a week, start 1 January 2027. It is project funded, so likely fixed term (inferred), and in Lyngby rather than central Copenhagen. Apply by 29 Nov; over 100 people have clicked apply.

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Communications Specialist
jobs.notes: Corporate comms for an employee-owned engineering, planning and environmental consultancy, so the built environment angle you liked at VELUX. Asks for 4 to 6 years in corporate or agency comms, which you just meet, though the senior title is a small stretch. Good pay and hybrid in Vancouver. 44 people have clicked apply.

jobs.title: Conseiller.ere medias sociaux et production video, Mila Ventures
jobs.workModel: Hybrid, minimum 3 days a week in the office
jobs.notes: Social media and video production for Mila's startup studio: editorial direction, community and audio and video content. It asks for 3 to 5 years and French and English, both of which you have, and it mixes tech and startups, two of your sectors. The gap is Montreal rather than Vancouver, and pay is not stated. 30 people have clicked apply.

jobs.title: Communications Coordinator
jobs.notes: External comms and media relations at one of the world's best-known arts venues, asking for 2+ years and strong content writing, which you have. Squarely cultural sector. The base salary sits a little under your target before super. Check work rights for Australia. Applications close 29 Nov; over 100 people have clicked apply.

jobs.title: Senior Communications and Content Coordinator
jobs.notes: Multi-channel campaigns for Monash's Faculty of Education, including planning and producing video, audio and visual content yourself. Strong pay and a good mix of copy and video. Senior level and works with a lot of autonomy, so a small stretch. Check work rights for Australia. Posted today.

jobs.title: Research Communications Officer
jobs.notes: Turning research on First Nations digital inclusion into social content, reports and promotional material, working closely with researchers. A good use of your anthropology and research background as well as your content skills. Fixed term to December 2027. Check work rights for Australia. 74 people have clicked apply.

jobs.title: Online Content Producer
jobs.notes: Council video and multimedia role: storyboarding, filming, photography, editing and scripts for the website and social channels, plus a monthly day off. Very hands-on video work that matches your skills. The gap is the outer Melbourne location. Check work rights for Australia. 22 people have clicked apply.

jobs.title: Experience Developer
jobs.notes: Developing museum experiences and exhibitions for non-expert audiences at a Tiriti-led museum, open to people from storytelling, cultural and audience-focused backgrounds. Your anthropology and documentary work fit well. The gap is that they want museum interpretive planning experience. Check work rights for New Zealand. Only 9 people have clicked apply.

jobs.title: Yoga Practitioner (full time)
jobs.salary: Paid (amount not stated), plus housing and meals
jobs.notes: Full-time paid yoga role at a heritage countryside hotel, leading morning and evening yoga, pranayama and meditation, with on-site housing and meals included. That matches your paid plus accommodation rule. Pay, hours and start date are not published, so ask before you commit.
